subject: Problems creating capthist file in secr

messages.author: 9f147340cc598da4
messages.subject: Problems creating capthist file in secr
parts:
Dear Murray et al

I have tried really hard to work out this issue by myself but am really struggling.

I am new to secr and am trying to analyse a leopard dataset of camera trap detections. I have 56 detections of 13 leopards over 63 occasions. I have fallen at the first hurdle, which is creating the capthist file and I can't work out what the issue is. Here is my script:

library(secr)

captfile<-system.file("newdir","leocapt.txt",package="secr")

> trapfile<-system.file("newdir","leotrap.txt",package="secr")

> leoCH<-read.capthist(captfile,trapfile,detector="proximity")

Error in rep(NA, nfield - nvar) : invalid 'times' argument

In addition: Warning message:

In max(do.call(count.fields, countargs)) :

  no non-missing arguments to max; returning -Inf



I attach the two files I am trying to build the capthist file with.

Any ideas?

With gratitude,

Bryony

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: Problems creating capthist file in secr
parts:
Hello Bryony
system.file() is used to retrieve the full names of files distributed with the package - you don't use that for your own input files.
Also, you need to comment out the header line of leorap.txt with #, just as you did with leocapt.txt.
Then it works fine.
Murray

captfile <- "leocapt.txt"
trapfile <- "leotrap.txt"
leoCH <- read.capthist(captfile, trapfile, detector="proximity")
summary(leoCH, terse = TRUE)
plot(leoCH, gridspace = 10000, tracks = TRUE, rad = 500)
# etc.
